# Agentic Readiness Score

> The Agentic Readiness Score, published by The Optimisers, measures how ready a business is for AI agents: whether AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Google's AI can find, understand, recommend and transact with it.

Agentic readiness: Agentic readiness is how prepared a business is for AI agents: assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity that research, recommend and increasingly act on a customer’s behalf. A business with high agentic readiness can be reached by AI crawlers, is understood correctly, is named when customers ask for a recommendation, publishes machine-readable data, and can take an enquiry or order through an agent.

## Key pages
- [Free agentic readiness checker](https://agenticreadiness.ai/check/): automatic check of four pillars from a website
- [What is agentic readiness?](https://agenticreadiness.ai/what-is-agentic-readiness/)
- [How it works](https://agenticreadiness.ai/how-it-works/)
- [Methodology](https://agenticreadiness.ai/methodology/)

## The five pillars
- [P1 Technical Access](https://agenticreadiness.ai/pillars/technical-access/): Whether AI crawlers and agents are allowed in, and can find every page.
- [P2 Content Extractability](https://agenticreadiness.ai/pillars/content-extractability/): Whether your content can be read, quoted and summarised accurately.
- [P3 Brand Command](https://agenticreadiness.ai/pillars/brand-command/): How often AI assistants name you when customers ask, and how they describe you.
- [P4 Data Liquidity](https://agenticreadiness.ai/pillars/data-liquidity/): Whether your products, prices, services and details are machine-readable.
- [P5 Transaction Readiness](https://agenticreadiness.ai/pillars/transaction-readiness/): Whether an AI agent could enquire, book or buy on a customer’s behalf.

## Facts
- Brand Command: 19 customer questions (discovery, evaluation, transaction), 5 runs each, web search on and off
- Confidence ratio: mention rate with web search divided by mention rate without it
- Scale: 0 to 100; bands Invisible (0-19), Low visibility (20-39), Emerging (40-59), Visible (60-79), Leading (80-100)
- Method version 1.0, November 2026
